$comment: Credential profiles for scripts/creds.py. NAMES ONLY — never a value. A keychain profile's values live in the macOS login Keychain under service 'alethia-creds', account '<profile>/<VAR>', stored with `pnpm creds --set <profile>` (the maintainer types it; input is not echoed). An aws-secret profile reads a JSON secret through the aws CLI's own credentials. Add a machine-local profile in ~/.alethia/creds-profiles.json (same shape); it overrides a repo profile of the same name.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare API token (DNS, Workers, status page).

stripe-live.description: Stripe LIVE-mode secret key. Real money: only on an explicit maintainer instruction.

github-admin.description: A GitHub token with admin scopes beyond the gh CLI's own login (rulesets, org settings).

platform-alert-paging.description: The platform paging channel's destination for scripts/ops/platform-alert-paging.ts: a webhook/Slack/Teams/... URL, or a PagerDuty routing key. Not needed for an email channel.

tofu-sandbox.description: Inputs for infra/sandbox when its local tfvars file is absent.

prod-env.description: Every key of the production app secret (AWS Secrets Manager), as env vars.
